Engineering change notice ECN-2240: CP-200 casing wear ring material › Engineering change notice ECN-2240
# Engineering change notice ECN-2240
| Change notice | ECN-2240 |
Effective March 1, 2025, casing wear ring PN-2840-A (bronze) is superseded by PN-2840-B (carbon-filled PTFE composite) on all CP-200 pumps.
Fit PN-2840-B whenever a wear ring is replaced.
Affected parts
| PN-2840-A | PN-2840-B | Use up stock on pumps above 80 °C only |

Engineering change notice ECN-2291: CP-200 mechanical seal › Engineering change notice ECN-2291
# Engineering change notice ECN-2291
| Change notice | ECN-2291 |
Effective September 14, 2026, mechanical seal PN-4471-B is superseded by PN-4471-C on all CP-200 pumps.
PN-4471-C has a silicon-carbide face rated for higher seal-water temperatures.
Fit PN-4471-C at the next seal replacement and quarantine remaining PN-4471-B stock.
Reason for the change: three PN-4471-B failures in 2026 were traced to wear of the carbon face at seal-water temperatures above 60 °C.
The manual will be revised in 2027; until then, this notice takes precedence over it.

Replacing the CP-200 mechanical seal (training) › Replacing the CP-200 mechanical seal › Parts and tools
- Seal cartridge PN-4471-C
- New casing gaskets PN-2205-C
Remaining PN-4471-B stock is quarantined; never fit it.
